summary.title: 我正在研发先进封装材料和光刻胶残留的紫外激发光学检测模块。模块以 355 n
summary.question:
我正在研发先进封装材料和光刻胶残留的紫外激发光学检测模块。模块以 355 nm 附近的光激发样品，需要压低收集通道中的激发光泄漏，同时保留可见波段的荧光信息，并抑制辅助近红外对准光进入可见探测通道。请设计空气入射、入射角 0 deg、非偏振 unpolarized、熔融石英基底上的平面多层介质滤光膜：在 355-365 nm 和 1030-1080 nm 两个干扰波段分别尽可能降低平均透射率，在 420-700 nm 信号波段尽可能提高平均透射率。膜层仅允许 Ta2O5 和 SiO2，总层数不超过 36 层。
单层膜厚（layer thickness）：20-350 nm。
请通过实际仿真比较不同膜系，分析通带损耗与双阻带抑制的折中，给出材料顺序、厚度和各目标波段结果。评价对象是检测模块中的滤光元件。

problem.compatibility_reason: Request specifies planar isotropic layered media with linear materials under frequency-domain illumination, fitting the Harness scope.

metrics.rationale: 用户明确要求'在 355-365 nm 干扰波段尽可能降低平均透射率'，用于压低紫外激发光泄漏到收集通道。
用户明确要求'在 1030-1080 nm 干扰波段尽可能降低平均透射率'，用于抑制辅助近红外对准光进入可见探测通道。
用户明确要求'在 420-700 nm 信号波段尽可能提高平均透射率'，用于保留可见波段的荧光信息。

scoring.metric_rationale: 这三个指标完整覆盖用户请求的三波段滤光需求：两个阻带（355-365 nm 紫外激发光和 1030-1080 nm 近红外对准光）需要最小化透射率，一个通带（420-700 nm 可见荧光信号）需要最大化透射率。选用 mean_transmittance 而非 worst_case_transmittance 是因为用户原文明确使用'平均透射率'表述。未添加第四个指标是因为三波段已完整表达设计目标，额外指标会稀释核心权衡关系的权重。入射角 0 deg 和非偏振条件使用默认通道，无需在 region 中指定 angle_deg 或 polarization。
scoring.formula_rationale: 该表达式将可见光波段的透射率视为正向收益，对应保留荧光信号的需求；将紫外和近红外波段的透射率视为负向损耗，对应抑制激发光泄漏和对准光干扰的需求。由于所有指标均为 0 到 1 之间的透射率分数，量纲一致，且用户未明确指定三个波段性能之间的相对优先级，因此各项系数设为 1，避免引入任意权重导致排名偏差，确保评分公平反映整体滤光性能。

routes.title: UV-Centered Quarter-Wave Stack for Maximum Excitation Suppression
routes.scientific_hypothesis: A quarter-wave stack centered at 355 nm will achieve deeper UV stopband suppression than visible-centered designs, but at the cost of increased passband ripple in the 420-700 nm region.
routes.design_principle: Bragg reflection condition: alternating high/low index layers with optical thickness λ/4 at the target stopband wavelength creates constructive interference for reflection. Centering at 355 nm maximizes reflectance at the excitation wavelength.
known_risks: Visible passband may show significant ripple due to stopband edges
NIR stopband at 1030-1080 nm may be weaker as it relies on higher-order reflection
36 layers may increase thermal stress per L28

routes.title: 36-layer alternating Ta2O5/SiO2 dual-stopband Bragg stack with thickness optimization
routes.scientific_hypothesis: A 36-layer alternating high-low index stack with independently tunable layer thicknesses can achieve simultaneous suppression at 355-365 nm and 1030-1080 nm while maintaining transmittance above 80% in 420-700 nm, by exploiting the natural harmonic relationship between quarter-wave stack reflection bands.
routes.design_principle: Quarter-wave Bragg stacks produce high reflectance at the design wavelength and its harmonics. By optimizing individual layer thicknesses rather than fixing them at quarter-wave values, the stack can be tuned to create two distinct stopbands at non-harmonically-related wavelengths while keeping the intermediate visible region as a passband. The large index contrast between Ta2O5 (n~2.1-2.3) and SiO2 (n~1.45-1.47) provides strong reflection per pair, reducing the number of layers needed for deep stopbands.
